### York Space Systems to Release Third Quarter 2026 Results on November 12, 2026


October 29, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/622448243/files/doc_news/York-Space-Systems-to-Release-Third-Quarter-2026-Results-on-November-12-2026-2026.pdf)


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[York Space Systems Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yorkspacesystems.com%2F&esheet=54630481&newsitemid=20261029734216&lan=en-US&anchor=York+Space+Systems+Inc.&index=1&md5=a57938cc1e973069d9ff49bb0fa4d40e) (NYSE: YSS) will release its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 after the close of market on Thursday, November 12, 2026. In conjunction with this release, York will host a conference call to review its financial results for the quarter, discuss its outlook for the future and may disclose other material developments affecting its business and/or financial performance. Listeners may access the conference call live via an audio webcast.


Thursday, November 12, 2026
3:00 pm Mountain Time (5:00 pm Eastern Time)
Webcast:[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/739520037](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2Furl%3Fq%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fevents.q4inc.com%252Fattendee%252F739520037%26sa%3DD%26source%3Dcalendar%26ust%3D1793556180000000%26usg%3DAOvVaw1UiPlhzRp_h_gxAr_fs26V&esheet=54630481&newsitemid=20261029734216&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F739520037&index=2&md5=dea2d2cad3c9e92db70d5f16e102cffb)


York’s financial results release will be available after the close of market on November 12, 2026 on York’s website at[http://ir.yorkspacesystems.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fir.yorkspacesystems.com&esheet=54630481&newsitemid=20261029734216&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fir.yorkspacesystems.com&index=3&md5=9afd8a5d2c9a88c3a64078a17b6a379d) . An audio webcast replay of the conference call will be available for one year at[http://ir.yorkspacesystems.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fir.yorkspacesystems.com&esheet=54630481&newsitemid=20261029734216&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fir.yorkspacesystems.com&index=4&md5=5d70d1d29da9b4957b3821bb2a45a496) .


**About York Space Systems**


[York Space Systems](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yorkspacesystems.com%2F&esheet=54630481&newsitemid=20261029734216&lan=en-US&anchor=York+Space+Systems&index=5&md5=958a361a86f93104396657bf69b26f5c) (NYSE: YSS) is a leading, U.S.-based national defense and commercial prime providing a comprehensive suite of mission-critical solutions for national security, government, and commercial customers. York is one of the only space and defense primes with proprietary hardware and software capabilities designed to address customers’ complex mission requirements across the critical elements of the entire space ecosystem throughout the mission lifecycle. York is purpose built to address evolving national security space challenges and to adapt to the ongoing shift in the U.S. government’s mission needs and procurement processes.
